The '''Republic police gunship''' was a model of [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] utilized by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] and the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Description==
[[File:PoliceGunships-TCAJ.png|thumb|left|220px|Police gunships patrolling the Coruscant underworld]]
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] possessed a spoked cockpit and [[Solar collector/Legends|solar gatherer panels]], which acted as the power generators for the ship. It also possessed a similar drive to the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] gunships, as evidenced by their sound.<ref name="To Catch a Jedi" /> They were also equipped with searchlights in the event that they had to conduct searches at night or in areas of Coruscant where visibility was low, such as the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]]. The gunships also had two ball-mounted laser cannons underneath the cockpit and one laser cannon mounted on the rear of the ship.<ref name="To Catch a Jedi gallery" /><ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The gunship was available to both droid and sentient members of the CSF. It was less armed than the LAAT/i, but was nonetheless preferred due to its better suitability for patrolling the city scape as well as it having a lower risk overall in causing collateral damage. The vehicle's cockpit also had two seats for the pilot and gunner, with the pilot being slightly behind of and elevated over the gunner. The side hatches opened for entry, and had a ramp near the rear in the event that the circumstances required rapid deployment of its personnel. It was primarily utilized by CSF police officers, although it was also known to be used by members of the Coruscant Guard under certain circumstances.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==History==
[[File:PoliceGunship-TCAJ.png|thumb|220px|A CSF police gunship with Coruscant Guards]]
The Republic police gunships were utilized on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] as troop transports and search vehicles. They were also used by the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] for the same purposes, when requested by [[Fox/Legends|Commander Fox]].<ref name="To Catch a Jedi" /><ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Two of these gunships were used on Coruscant by two teams of [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guards]] led by clone officers Captain [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and Commander [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]] and Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] to search for Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] in the lower levels, after Tano escaped from the [[Republic military base]].<ref name="To Catch a Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic police gunship first appeared in the Season 5 episode "[[To Catch a Jedi]]." The ship was originally designed for another ''Star Wars''-related project, and was inherited by the ''Clone Wars'' team for use in this episode.<ref name="To Catch a Jedi gallery" />

A LEGO version of the gunship (LEGO STAR WARS - 75046 Coruscant Police Gunship) was released in 2014.

===The New Yoda Chronicles===
{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
Following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] took a police gunship to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] rendezvous point on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] along with [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].
{{Noncanonend}}
